Hi Mateusz,

Thanks for your rapid response! I loaded the Spectronaut file directly (without renaming the Columns)to the converter, and the conversion seemed to work well until the last step when appearing this message:

#Import specific Spectronaut data

raw <-read.csv("232_MSstats_total_no-norm.csv",header = TRUE,"," )
Raw_filtered <- raw %>% filter(F.FrgLossType =="noloss", F.ExcludedFromQuantification=="False")
   

quant <- SpectronauttoMSstatsFormat(Raw_filtered,
                                    annotation =NULL,
                                    intensity = "F.PeakArea",
                                    filter_with_Qvalue = TRUE,
                                    qvalue_cutoff = 0.01,
                                    useUniquePeptide = TRUE,
                                    removeFewMeasurements = FALSE,
                                    removeProtein_with1Feature = FALSE,
                                    summaryforMultipleRows = max,
                                    use_log_file = TRUE,
                                    append = FALSE,
                                    verbose = TRUE,
                                    log_file_path = NULL)
